text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training with Narita 
Brian...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Brian-san! Hayahide-san is in the 
infirmary...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Narita Brian heard the story, 
she sprinted off at furious speed!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian...? What's the matter? You look 
pale.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ngh, did you... get hurt...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she hit a wall, but it's 
nothing to worry about... is that it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...However, the way I was called made it 
sound like something serious had 
happened."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, there's a reason for that, you 
see...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO~N!! They told me I was crying 
way too dramatically agaaaain~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I think crying is good for your health.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's scientifically proven that crying 
relaxes both the mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Crying secretes serotonin, which brings a 
sense of fatigue along with a restful 
sleep effect. In other words, after you 
cry, you get a good night's sleep—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And while Biwa Hayahide spoke with a 
proud expression, she walked straight 
through the hallway corner, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaah~~!! Hayahideeee~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Someone, help! Hayahide... Hayahide is――!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket ran around shouting for help at the 
top of her lungs, which led to me being 
carried in here. That's probably why the 
incident sounded so exaggerated.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh* So, are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, I only bumped it. It's truly 
nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... Let me see it anyway.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Somehow, it brings back memories 
of the old days.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis. Don't say unnecessary things...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I crashed into a fence 
and got seriously hurt. She kept cheering 
me up the whole time I was in the 
hospital...

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sis... Is that injury gonna be 
okay...?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I told you, we still don't know...

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I-It'll be fine. If it's Sis, I know she 
can do it..."

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I'll stay by your side until you're all 
better...! So don't worry, it's gonna be 
okay...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right. Ah, seeing your face 
reminded me of back then..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why am I getting so sentimental...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine, so you didn't need to 
see me off, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...We just happened to be heading in the 
same direction.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Either way, thank you. And also—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Though it was unintentional, I have made 
you worry once again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As long as nothing's wrong... then it's 
fine.
choice_data_list:
You really care about your sister, don't 
you?

You really care about your sister, don't 
you?
You really are clumsy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
As long as nothing's wrong... then it's 
fine.
choice_data_list:
You really care about your sister, don't 
you?

You really care about your sister, don't 
you?
You really are clumsy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, indeed. She really is such a sweet 
sister who cares so much for her elder 
sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wipe that smug look off your face...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I bet you spouted trivia with that exact 
same face even when you hit a wall...!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wha! That couldn't be true... or at least, 
it shouldn't be...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Geez... Spare me a third time, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she spoke those words, Narita 
Brian quietly breathed a sigh of relief.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Indeed... You're completely right...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're talking about Sis, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, no matter how you look at it, they're 
talking about you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I meant that referring to the two of 
them... but their reactions are so funny, 
I think I'll just leave it uncorrected.
